dialogues.speaker: Jonvelle
dialogues.text: Hmm, if we go with this angle, the Flowcurrent Birds... Ah, hello there. Is something the matter?

response.speaker: Jonvelle
response.text: Why, yes indeed! I've gotten the pictures I wanted, but since the costs of traveling from Fontaine to Natlan aren't cheap...

response.speaker: Jonvelle
response.text: I might as well take a few extra shots, right?

choices.text: What do you like about Flowcurrent Birds, exactly?

response.speaker: Jonvelle
response.text: Ah, many things! Some love their feet, some their feathers...

response.speaker: Jonvelle
response.text: But if you ask me, their most attractive trait is the way their feathers glisten under the sunlight when they emerge from the water.

response.speaker: Jonvelle
response.text: In that moment, their feathers look so eminently... fluffable!

choices.text: Nothing in particular. See you around.
